hypotheses.construction_plan: Treat the common symbolic form V(theta)*G0(theta)*V(theta) as a kernel. Substituting theta=p gives the first summand; substituting theta=q gives the second summand.
required_assumptions: The symbols p and q can be substituted for the parameter theta in undefined functions.
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are syntactically identical except for the free symbol p versus q, so they are evaluations of the same univariate symbolic kernel at two different arguments.

hypotheses.construction_plan: Use the AC-normalized form G0(theta)*V(theta)**2 as a parameterized template. Substituting theta with p or q reproduces the two members of the observed structural family F01.
required_assumptions: Multiplication is commutative and associative, so V(x)*G0(x)*V(x) can be rewritten as G0(x)*V(x)**2.
hypotheses.rationale: The AC-equivalent observation already collapses the two factors of V into V(theta)**2 and places G0(theta) first; this is a normalized one-parameter family matching that structural observation.
